title: Cross-domain closure validations: Litigation, Reserves & Provider deep check
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01: seeds 2 active litigation cases on CLM-2024-001, opens the closure modal directly

walkthroughSteps.title: Blockers from three domains, one card style
walkthroughSteps.body: Litigation, reserves, and provider all feed the same generic blocker card list below: each shows a count-derived label; expand a card to see the individual items behind it.

walkthroughSteps.title: Go to Litigation
walkthroughSteps.body: '2 active litigation case(s) must be resolved': click the card to expand and see each case, or use this link.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Closes the modal and navigates to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation.

walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-02: seeds open reserve lines + a provider flag on CLM-2024-001 instead

walkthroughSteps.title: Reserves & provider blockers
walkthroughSteps.body: Reserves shows '<n> open reserve line(s) must be released: €<total>' (the amount was already computed but never rendered: fixed). Provider shows 'Provider instructions must be finalised' with a 'Go to Provider Management' link: the Provider Management page didn't exist when this ticket was written; now that it does, provider gets a real deep link too, same as litigation.

walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-03: all three blockers present at once: litigation + reserves + provider, all in the same card list

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Litigation blocker shows case count + Go to Litigation link
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
When 2 active litigation cases exist, the closure modal shows a blocker with the count and a Go to Litigation link that navigates on click.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira AC2 says: "Any BC responds blocked, closure halted; handler shown domain-specific blocking reason(s)". Jira says nothing about links. The "Go to Litigation" (and Go to Provider Management) links are made up by the prototype. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 already has 2 'In progress' litigation entries in mock data: no flag override needed. Tasks + sections must be clear so only litigation blocks closure.

preconditions.text: Close Claim shows litigation blocker with count '2'
'Go to Litigation' link is present in blocker item
Clicking 'Go to Litigation' closes modal and navigates to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation

expectedUI.description: Litigation blocker with real count from service query
visualCues: Modal step 1: blocker label: '2 active litigation case(s) must be resolved'
'Go to Litigation' link rendered as an underlined blue button
Clicking link: modal closes, browser routes to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation

howToTest.expectedResult: Modal step 1 shows litigation blocker with count 2 and a Go to Litigation link

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Reserves blocker shows line count + EUR total
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
When open reserve lines exist, the closure popup shows a blocker with the count and the total in euro, e.g. *2 open reserve line(s) must be released, €45,000*. The reserves blocker has no link. The provider blocker reads *Provider instructions must be finalised* and now has a **Go to Provider Management** link (the Provider Management page exists now).

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira AC3 says only: "Reserves: confirms no pending reserves/payments; marks reserves to zero at their end". The line count and euro total in the label are made up by the prototype. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 is linked to POL-2023-010 which has seeded reserve lines in MockReservesService. Tasks + sections cleared, litigation cleared via flag override. Provider flag set to demonstrate a flag-only blocker alongside a deep blocker.

preconditions.text: Reserves blocker shows count and euro total
Provider blocker shows a 'Go to Provider Management' link

expectedUI.description: Reserves blocker with count and euro total; provider blocker with a Go to Provider Management link
visualCues: Popup step 1, reserves blocker: 'X open reserve line(s) must be released, €YY,YYY'
Provider blocker: 'Provider instructions must be finalised' with a 'Go to Provider Management' link

howToTest.expectedResult: Popup step 1 shows the reserves blocker with line count and euro total, and the provider blocker with a Go to Provider Management link

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All three blockers visible at once: deep + flag-only
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Litigation (count 2, Go to Litigation), reserves (count and euro total, no link) and provider (Go to Provider Management) all appear at the same time in the same popup step.

setup.description: Tasks + sections cleared. CLM-2024-001 already has 2 active litigation records in mock data. Reserves are seeded for POL-2023-010. Provider flag set. No hasActiveLitigation override needed: the real service query fires.

preconditions.text: Popup shows 3 blockers: litigation (count 2), reserves (count and amount), provider (with link)

expectedUI.description: All three blockers shown; litigation and reserves are enriched with detail
visualCues: Litigation: '2 active litigation case(s) must be resolved' with Go to Litigation
Reserves: 'X open reserve line(s) must be released, €YYY,YYY'
Provider: 'Provider instructions must be finalised' with Go to Provider Management

howToTest.trigger: Click Close Claim after applying AC-03 setup
howToTest.expectedResult: 3 blockers visible in one step; litigation and provider have Go to links, reserves has none
